subject.title: Control UI: Config upgrade/hardening suggestions should apply changes automatically with before/after diff and user acceptance, not direct users to edit files manually

question: Which Control UI recommendation actions may write config automatically, and what confirmation, diff, audit, restart, and approval policy must wrap security/auth changes?
rationale: The source shows the write primitive exists, but deciding when UI hardening advice may become an executable config change crosses a product/security boundary rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Allowlisted recommendation actions
options.body: Permit a narrow maintainer-approved set of recommendations to propose config.patch changes with before/after diff, explicit acceptance, audit note, and restart messaging.

options.title: Manual guidance only
options.body: Keep security-sensitive recommendations as docs and copyable config snippets, accepting the current UX friction and support burden.

options.title: Defer to protected-config policy
options.body: Wait for #77886 or a shared protected-config approval policy before adding Control UI-specific apply actions.

recommendation.title: Allowlisted recommendation actions
recommendation.body: Permit a narrow maintainer-approved set of recommendations to propose config.patch changes with before/after diff, explicit acceptance, audit note, and restart messaging.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans recent Control UI, config safety, and security-auth behavior where steipete has the strongest observed history signal.
